meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 驱动下的代理会获得 Gmail 工具:可搜索、读取、发送、起草、删除邮件,管理标签和过滤器,下载附件。工具以 mcp__gmail__ 开头;OneCLI 在请求时注入真实凭据,容器内只有占位符。
howto.when: 当用户要求为代理接入 Gmail 邮箱(例如“把 Gmail 加为工具”)时触发。流程会检查 OneCLI 连接、写入占位凭据、为所选代理组注册 Gmail 并重启验证。

say.text: 列出我的 Gmail 标签
say.note: 会调用 Gmail 的标签列表工具。

say.text: 搜索我上个月收件箱里的发票
say.note: 会触发 Gmail 邮件搜索工具。

say.text: 用 Gmail 给李雷发一封邮件,说下午开会
say.note: 会调用发送邮件工具;需先完成 Gmail 授权。

howto.what_en: After install the agent gains Gmail tools: search, read, send, draft, delete, labels, filters, attachments. They appear as mcp__gmail__*; OneCLI injects real credentials at request time; container holds only placeholders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks to add Gmail to an agent (e.g. “add Gmail as a tool”). Then it checks OneCLI, writes stub credentials, registers Gmail for selected groups, rebuilds, and verifies.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month.
Send an email to Li Lei saying the meeting is at 3pm.
say_en.note: Calls send_email, requires OAuth set up.
